rules.description: Error budget burning >=14.4x in 1h AND >=6x in 6h: ~2% of a 30-day budget gone in an hour. Page the on-call now.
rules.name: fast-burn

rules.description: Sustained elevated burn: >=3x over 6h OR >=1x over 72h (budget being consumed at or above the sustainable rate for 3 days). Open a ticket and investigate before it pages.
rules.name: slow-burn
